providers.name: Henry County Smith River Blueway Bassett and Great Road access anchors
providers.method: The Smith River Blueway and Henry County tourism access pages identify Bassett River Access and The Great Road River Access as public paddling accesses with addresses, distances, class guidance, parking, and safety instructions. Bassett coordinates are corroborated by a Dan River Basin Association outing record; The Great Road coordinates are an address/access-area anchor. Neither coordinate is asserted to be a surveyed wetted-edge point; verify the rustic carry, parking, entry/exit, and current public status.

providers.name: Virginia DWR Upper Clinch River Blackford Bridge and Puckett's Hole access anchors
providers.method: Virginia DWR lists Blackford Bridge on the Clinch River as a public gravel access and Puckett's Hole as a public shoreline access. Coordinates are access-area anchors, not surveyed wetted-edge launch points. Verify current carry, water entry/exit, parking, road conditions, legal boundaries, and posted rules before relying on either endpoint.

providers.name: Virginia DWR Nottoway River Double Bridge and Route 630 ramp anchors
providers.method: Virginia DWR names the Double Bridge to Route 630 float and identifies both endpoints as DWR ramps. Coordinates use the DWR public maintained-access map anchors associated with the official float map; they are access-area controls, not a claim that every bridge point is a surveyed wetted-edge launch. Verify current carry, parking, water entry, closure status, and posted rules.

providers.name: Virginia DWR Rivanna River Crofton and Palmyra public-landing anchors
providers.method: Virginia DWR's public-landings map names Crofton to Palmyra as a 6.5-mile float and its maintained access inventory supplies the Crofton anchor; DWR's official Palmyra place page supplies the downstream access coordinate. These are access-area anchors rather than surveyed wetted-edge points. Verify current carry, parking, water entry/exit, landing status, and the hard Palmyra take-out boundary before launching.
